description: Each resolver's declared poster.profiles `extras` keys (ADR-0033 names the object; the keys are each resolver's 6.2 fields less what the flat fields and ADR-0033's signals replace). Every key is optional. poster-resolver re-emits a cached profile with the extras of the resolver that wrote it. The types are the `extras` schema's (src/context.ts). Producer mode refuses a key its resolver does not declare; an ordinary individual's answer carries no extras.
